definitions.gloss: acne scar; pimple mark; blemish from acne
definitions.explanation: A mark, discoloration, or indentation left on the skin after acne has healed. A common concern discussed in skincare and dermatology contexts.

examples.japanese: ニキビ{跡|あと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}って→残る：01187_nokoru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I ended up with acne scars.

examples.japanese: ニキビ{跡|あと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消|け}す→消す：00528_kesu⟧⟦クリーム→クリーム：00253_kuriimu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for a cream to remove acne scars.

examples.japanese: ニキビ{跡|あと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{消|き}えない→消える：02520_kieru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{皮膚科|ひふか}→皮膚科：11073_hifuka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}する→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧ことにした。
examples.english: Since the acne scars wouldn't go away, I decided to consult a dermatologist.

notes:
Composed of ⟦ニキビ→ニキビ：22122_nikibi⟧ (acne, pimple) + ⟦{跡|あと}→跡：02174_ato⟧ (mark, trace). A very common concern for young people in Japan, frequently discussed on skincare websites, beauty forums, and in dermatology clinics.

Types of ニキビ{跡|あと} include {赤|あか}み (redness), ⟦{色素|しきそ}{沈着|ちんちゃく}→色素沈着：27280_shikisochinchaku⟧ (pigmentation), and クレーター (pitted scars, from English "crater").

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ニキビ{跡|あと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧: acne scars remain
- ニキビ{跡|あと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消|け}す→消す：00528_kesu⟧: to remove acne scars
- ニキビ{跡|あと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{治|なお}す→治す：19371_naosu⟧: to treat acne scars
- ニキビ{跡|あと}⟦ケア→ケア：10848_kea⟧: acne scar care
- ニキビ{跡|あと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{赤|あか}み: redness from acne scars

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ニキビ→ニキビ：22122_nikibi⟧: acne, pimple — the active blemish itself, not the scar
- ⟦{吹|ふ}き{出物|でもの}→吹き出物：08546_fukidemono⟧: breakout, skin eruption — a more general or adult-sounding term for acne
- ⟦{傷跡|きずあと}→傷跡：14893_kizuato⟧: scar — a general term for any scar from injury
